timeline.summary: UK Court dismissed Comex's £543,501 claim against subsidiary Clearcomm Group following an out-of-court settlement of £25,000.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹203.08 Cr, net loss to shareholders ₹46.89 Cr.
On May 9, 2026, STL Networks reported that shareholders approved postal ballot resolutions including material related party transactions and borrowing powers.
Delhi High Court dismissed STL Networks' petition to set aside the arbitral award dated May 9, 2023, in the dispute with BSNL.
STL Networks issued a corrigendum to its postal ballot notice adding a revised valuation report for the preferential warrant issue to promoter Twin Star Overseas Limited.
STL Networks announced shareholder approval for Articles of Association alteration and preferential warrant issue to promoter Twin Star Overseas via postal ballot.
STL Networks clarified to stock exchanges that 25% of preferential issue proceeds will fund general corporate purposes and unutilized funds will be parked in FDs or mutual funds.
Ankit Agarwal, of Pune, confirmed no new encumbrances on his STL Networks shares as of April 5, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Jyoti Agarwal, Pravin Agarwal, and Pravin Agarwal Family Trust confirmed no new encumbrances on their STL Networks shares beyond FY2025-26 disclosures, filed April 05, 2026.
STL Networks received ₹27 Cr as 25% initial subscription for the ₹108 Cr preferential warrant issue to promoter Twin Star Overseas.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹270.11 Cr (+17.0% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹16.13 Cr (against a loss of ₹19.29 Cr a year earlier).
